summary: Apex Order Pickup Solutions (grown out of Apex Supply Chain Technologies) makes smart pickup lockers and the ApexIQ technology platform for contactless, asynchronous order handoff, deployed across 5,000+ locations including restaurants, campuses, hospitals and airports. (Scope note: The 5,000+ location figure spans multiple verticals (restaurants, campuses, hospitals, airports), not restaurants alone.)
Apex launched modular smart lockers (OrderHQ Array Series) for restaurant order pickup in 2025, and continued expanding automated pickup/guest-handoff features into 2026.
